summary: NIFTY 50 (NSE_INDEX, an EQIDX row of NSE_EQ) at Quote: the ohlcv packet becomes an index Quote frame with the change worked out from the previous close.

notes: No live index packet was recorded; an index's ohlcv packet carries volume 0.

deviations.reason: The desktop puts its mode label (ltp, quote, full) in data.mode; the Rupeezy web adapter sends no data.mode. Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

The Rupeezy web adapter adds the broker's instrument token as a string to every frame; the desktop's common carrier has no place for it. Whether the desktop carries it is the lead's decision (a broker identifier, not a market field).
The Rupeezy web adapter repeats ltp as last_price in every frame; the desktop sends no such alias yet.
The Rupeezy web adapter repeats the previous close as prev_close wherever the packet carries a close; the desktop sends no such alias yet.

The desktop sends the change under the canonical names price_change and price_change_percent beside the Rupeezy (change, change_percent) web names; price_change is not a docs key and the web adapter sends none, so it goes. Names follow each broker's own web adapter, mode by mode (lead ruling 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.
